title: The Graduate Rollover Amount for a Receiving School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The rollover amount for a receiving School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds five (5) serving days, a school week, of one reimbursable lunch at the elementary lunch charge of the student's meal status, with nothing else added, less the receiving account's balance, so a negative balance adds its unpaid meal charges to the rollover. The receiving account's balance for the rollover is its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, as they stand when the rollover is made.

It is put together in this order: first every charge counted for each serving day is added together into the day charge; then the day charge is multiplied by the serving days counted and every amount counted once is added; then the receiving account's balance is subtracted. The rollover amount is that total, never below nothing, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; a rollover of zero moves nothing.

### Worked amounts (hypothetical)

- Paid Meal Status, elementary lunch charge 3.10, five days 15.50; balance 11.80 below zero: rollover 27.30.
- Same status, balance 2.25: rollover 13.25.
- Reduced-Price Meal Status, elementary lunch charge 0.40, five days 2.00; balance 0.00: rollover 2.00.
- Paid Meal Status, balance 16.00: below nothing, so 0.00 and nothing moves.
